home.title: Find where to train for railway careers,
home.lead: From vocational certificates to engineering degrees, as an apprentice, a student or a career changer: every programme links to its official source and to the institutions that teach it.
home.searchPlaceholder: A job, a programme, a city… e.g. train driver, electrical engineering, Lille
home.doorJob: I have a job in mind
home.networkCaption: Verified institutions by region · click to open the map
home.familiesSub: Each family groups jobs linked to the programmes that lead to them. Pick a family, we show the way.
home.parcoursTitle: From vocational certificate to engineer, one track
home.parcoursSub: Each level opens the next. Example of a railway maintenance pathway, as it exists in the institutions on the map.
home.campusSub: The campuses and schools dedicated to rail: technical platforms, work-study programmes, diplomas recognised by the industry.
home.ctaTitle: Do you train for railway careers?
home.ctaSub: Keep your listing up to date: programmes, intake dates, open days, contact. After a review by the team, your institution shows as verified.
home.partners: A service run by Objectif OFP.
home.parcoursLegend: The numbers are the levels of the French qualifications framework: 3 = vocational certificate, 4 = high-school diploma, 5 = two years after, 6 = three years after, 7 = five years after, 8 = six years and more. The star groups professional certifications, open at any age.
